idea-plugin.name: Fixed Editor Width
idea-plugin.description:
Prevents the main editor panel from being squeezed when resizing the IDE window.


Features:

  • Hooks into IntelliJ's ThreeComponentsSplitter layout.
  • Directs window width adjustments exclusively into docked tool windows (such as the Run/Terminal panel).
  • Preserves editor text column layout when managing windows on Wayland/Linux tiling setups.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: Lock editor pane width on horizontal IDE window resizing.
